criteria.requirement: Add exported Schema(columns) and SchemaValidationError. A columns mapping declares nullable/unique booleans, inclusive min/max and finite choices. Validate a real Table without mutation, returning deterministic zero-based row/column/code records in row then configured-column order; never include actual values. Nulls bypass other checks, nullable defaults True, unique ignores nulls, and duplicate reports start at the second equal value. validate(table, strict=False, max_errors=None) supports an exact positive integer error cap and strict errors with an errors tuple. Copy caller rules, reject unknown/invalid rules, reversed bounds, invalid strict/caps and missing table columns before scanning.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
